About Us

About Medi Tech Admission Advisory

Medi Tech Admission Advisory is an education and admission consultancy providing guidance for medical, dental, AYUSH, nursing, paramedical and engineering admissions. We assist students with NEET counselling, college selection, choice filling, counselling guidance, document verification and admission-related support — for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, B.Sc Nursing, Pharmacy, Paramedical, B.Tech, BCA, MBA and other professional courses.

  • Personalised guidance for students and parents
  • NEET counselling and college selection support
  • Choice filling and counselling guidance
  • Document verification and admission support
  • Transparent communication
Medical, dental & AYUSH admission counselling
Nursing, pharmacy & paramedical guidance
Engineering & management admission support
End-to-end support through the counselling process

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Medi Tech Admission Advisory क्या services देता है?

Medical, dental, AYUSH, nursing, paramedical और engineering admissions के लिए counselling और admission guidance प्रदान करता है।

क्या NEET counselling में guidance मिलती है?

हाँ, NEET counselling, college selection और choice filling में guidance दी जाती है।

किन courses के लिए counselling उपलब्ध है?

MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, Nursing, Pharmacy, Paramedical, B.Tech, BCA, MBA आदि।

क्या college selection में मदद मिलती है?

हाँ, student की rank, category, domicile और eligibility के अनुसार available options समझाने में सहायता की जाती है।
